rows: What mineral is yellow ochre?
Goethite (α-FeOOH) — iron oxyhydroxide
What mineral is red ochre?
Hematite (α-Fe₂O₃) — iron oxide
How do you make red from yellow ochre?
Heat to ~200°C — dehydration converts goethite to hematite
What makes umber dry fast in oil?
Manganese content acts as siccative (oxidative polymerization catalyst)
What is bone black's blue undertone from?
Calcium phosphate matrix shifts absorption slightly — more blue reflected than pure carbon
Why do cave paintings survive 40,000 years?
Iron oxides are terminal oxidation products — chemically stable, UV-stable, insoluble
What was green earth used for?
Byzantine flesh underpainting (verdaccio) — complementary cool base under warm flesh tones
Why does ivory black no longer use ivory?
Originally from burned ivory tusks; now always animal bone. Same composition (carbon + calcium phosphate).
